answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 33092 Country: India Title: Can a woman apply lipstick or not? Question: Can a woman apply lipstick or not? People say that only the cheap brand manufactures use pig fat not the expensive ones. So please can you guide us what is exactly the fact and truth according to Islam? Answer ID: 33092 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1104/930/B=1432) It should be examined by two religious and expert Muslims in any laboratory what ingredients it includes? If the use of pig fat is proved then it is haram and impure and it is not lawful to apply it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
